title: Inspect exact subjects before submitting a recorded decision
actor: An engineering agent acting on an explicit project decision
goal: Obtain exact identities and any requested content for the engineering subjects on which the decision will rely.
context: The agent has identified relevant subjects and must communicate its actual observed basis in a later recording request.
trigger: The agent requests inspection of explicit contained subject paths.
preconditions: The selected root and paths are supplied under the published subject-inspection contract.

interaction.action: Requests identities and, where needed, content for the exact subjects it selected.
Returns each observed identity and requested content from the same inspected bytes, with explicit absence or a coherent failure result.
Uses the observed identities as its explicit expected decision basis when preparing a later operation.

expected_outcome: The agent obtains an attributable observed basis without dependency inference, execution of subject content, or silent refresh of its expectations.

alternatives.condition: Only byte identity is needed for a subject already understood.
alternatives.outcome: Identity-only inspection supplies the identity without returning the full payload.

alternatives.condition: The actor needs to require that a specific file remain absent.
alternatives.outcome: Inspection reports expected absence explicitly, suitable only for the declared absence precondition.

failures.condition: An observed change prevents a coherent identity/content set.
failures.outcome: The system returns conflict without a partial subject set.

failures.condition: A selected path is unsafe, unreadable, or too large for the requested content output.
failures.outcome: The system reports the specific failure without executing content, truncating it, or broadening the selection.
